subject.title: fix: filter out transport from stream override check to unblock Codex WS transport (#108614)

question: Should model-policy `params.transport` remain an authored request override that selects the OpenClaw embedded runtime, or should OpenClaw translate it into Codex app-server provider transport configuration?
rationale: The current documented selection contract and Codex's internal transport configuration are separate ownership boundaries; filtering the key chooses a direction implicitly without implementing the required translation.

options.title: Keep OpenClaw ownership
options.body: Treat `transport` as an authored override and repair the embedded OpenClaw provider path so it honors WebSocket or reports unsupported transport clearly.

options.title: Delegate transport to Codex
options.body: Define and test an explicit mapping from OpenClaw model policy into Codex provider WebSocket configuration before allowing Codex selection.

recommendation.title: Keep OpenClaw ownership
recommendation.body: Treat `transport` as an authored override and repair the embedded OpenClaw provider path so it honors WebSocket or reports unsupported transport clearly.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the recent merged provider/model runtime-selection contract most directly affected by the choice.
